grain: One row per eligible completed encounter.
inclusion_rules: encounter date is within the reporting period
exclusion_rules: cancelled encounters are excluded from completed-visit wait-time median
sql: WITH dedup AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY encounter_id ORDER BY source_updated_at DESC) rn FROM encounters) SELECT strftime('%Y-%W', encounter_date) AS week, department, COUNT(*) FROM dedup WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY week, department;

limitations: Wait-time completeness and operational context require confirmation.
